🆕 New listing (posted: September 24, 2026)

A licensed judicial scrivener (司法書士) will provide free consultations on inheritance, wills, and other legal matters including registration, court procedures, adult guardianship, company formation, and debt issues.

No reservation needed—first come, first served.

Each consultation is 30 minutes.

Please bring any documents related to your matter if you have them.

【Free Inheritance and Will Consultation Day】

Date and time: October 12, 2026 (Monday, Reiwa 8)
10:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m. (Reception closes at 2:00 p.m.)

Location: Hanno Citizen Activity Center (7th floor, Maruhiro Department Store Hanno branch) – Conference room

Organizer: Saitama Bar Association, Tokorozawa Chapter, Hanno Group

Inquiries: Anshin Succession and Adult Guardianship Office (Judicial Scrivener Watanabe)
Phone: 042-978-9005

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jinkenkurashianzen/kurashi/14113.html
